changes_from_source: 原作者短提示词改写；固定尺寸、时长及无外部素材基线。
checks: 至少 4 个可辨识的视觉段落
不出现 starter 占位画面
brief_en: Create a 15-second motion-design showreel for a fictional designer portfolio. Invent the visual direction, typography, geometric imagery and connected scene transitions. Show range while keeping a coherent identity. Use code-drawn visuals. A silent film is acceptable; do not spend time sourcing music.
brief_zh: 制作一段 15 秒虚构设计师作品集动效。自行决定视觉方向、字体排印、几何画面和连贯转场，兼顾变化和整体风格。图形用代码绘制。允许无声，不需要寻找音乐。
